intent.title: Retain required target evidence independently of Reviewer citations

purpose: inspection evidence; not a recovery checkpoint

risks.description: Automatic retention can silently lose exact bytes or conflate controller custody with Reviewer inspection. Preserve existing ownership and storage while retaining all required bytes independently of citations.

ownership.git_state: Existing runtime output remains ignored; raw account streams remain private and outside required evidence.
ownership.owner_after_creation: The producing target owns source files; no ownership transfer to a Developer or Reviewer.
ownership.owner_during_operation: The target remains source owner; Build reads and binds exact validated versions through publication.
ownership.paths: Target manifest and required source artifacts in existing target-owned retained runtime output locations
ownership.permitted_mutation: Creation before validation is allowed; mutation or deletion of bound sources before publication prevents publication.
ownership.upgrade_behavior: No historical rewrite, migration or new source cleanup policy.
ownership.validation: Strict schema, framing, repository containment including symlinks, regular files and SHA-256 of exact bytes at capture and publication.
ownership.when_exists: Preserve preexisting user files; use target-owned unique run locations and fail unsafe collisions. Sources must survive isolated supervisor cleanup.

ownership.git_state: Runtime records remain ignored; Complete copy is committed by the existing publication flow.
ownership.owner_after_creation: Build controller owns retained bytes immediately after capture.
ownership.owner_during_operation: Build controller owns current records; published Complete preserves immutable historical evidence. Reviewer citations retain separate role provenance.
ownership.paths: Controller-retained target snapshots in existing scenario-tracking runtime records and their self-contained Complete copies
ownership.permitted_mutation: Only existing verified controller updates may append current-attempt evidence; later attempts cannot replace prior exact-byte versions.
ownership.upgrade_behavior: Old receipts remain valid without manifests and are not backfilled; no retention service or storage migration.
ownership.validation: Recompute digests from decoded bytes, preserve source path and target/attempt provenance, and verify sources unchanged before publication.
ownership.when_exists: Follow existing exclusive Build record creation, integrity checks and Complete collision/rollback rules; never overwrite external changes or user-owned files.
